subject: React Native UniFFI bridge
use_case: Expose a specific Rust capability to Android and iOS
problem: Captured as a possible native bridge; no concrete capability currently requires it.
risks: A third native bridge strategy beside Nitro and existing Rust experiments
decision: Do not install. Move to TRIAL only when a concrete Rust capability has a benchmark and native API design.
revisit_when: A required native capability cannot be implemented safely with Expo modules, Nitro, or an existing package.
